title: Lumilens, which is building data center optical-interconnection tech to replace wires with light, raised $700M at a $5.5B valuation, for $900M in total funding (Anissa Gardizy/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Anissa Gardizy / Wall Street Journal: Lumilens, which is building data center optical-interconnection tech to replace wires with light, raised $700M at a $5.5B valuation, for $900M in total funding — Lumilens, which makes optical gear to speed up data flowing between AI servers, is valued at $5.5 billion in new funding
